title: Georgina R NDE
content:
For three months, I planned by death by overdose. When the drug got into my body, everything felt wrong. There was a dirty feeling and I felt distressed to be leaving my body. I felt like I was moving upwards into golden clouds. I was scared and my memory goes. Next thing I know, a celestial Being is moving me across the universe. It felt as though I was taken to the edge of the universe to be shown the view. It was fundamentally the most beautiful and amazing view that I had ever seen. I was not alone. There was something circular next to me on my left-hand side.

I suspect that most of my experience was removed from my memory.

Then, I was being forced back into my physical body. I did not want to come back to my life. I heard a voice tell me that I was not finished yet. I was devastated that I was forced back into my awful life.

I was hospitalized into a psychiatry facility. I started to receive instructions about how to manage my family and my husband at the time. I received instructions to start meditating, which I diligently followed. Two years later, I began communicating with what took me beyond. Ten years later, I was diagnosed with schizophrenia.

elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: No I clearly left my body and existed outside it
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: Normal consciousness and alertness. I can’t compare the two
elements.At what time during the experience were: When I was shown the universe and endless planets
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: I guess the communication was telepathic
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm. I was taken through the cosmos
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about the universe. I was completely connected to the universe
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will. I was literally pushed back into my physical body against my will
elements.Have your religious practices changed si: Yes I was forced to have a kundalini awakening
elements.Did your experience include features con: Content that was entirely not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I heard a voice I could not identify. It was a Male voice
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Yes I tend to isolate myself.
elements.How accurately do you remember the exper: I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes I tend to get a reaction of acceptance
